name: io.github.tangivis/twitter-mcp
description: Read and write Twitter/X with browser cookies — no API key, no billing. 62 tools covering tweets, users, lists, communities, DMs, and locally-decrypted XChat.

environmentVariables.name: TWITTER_COOKIES
environmentVariables.description: Path to a JSON file holding your X session cookies, e.g. {"ct0": "...", "auth_token": "..."} copied from DevTools. This is a filesystem path, not the credential itself; chmod 600 the file it points at.

environmentVariables.name: XCHAT_BROWSER
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Enables reading XChat (end-to-end encrypted DMs) from the browser's local decrypted store. One of: auto, chrome, chromium, edge, brave, aside. Unset means the XChat tools stay dormant.

environmentVariables.name: XCHAT_BROWSER_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Chromium profile directory to read, e.g. Default or 'Profile 2'. Set this when discovery finds more than one XChat store and refuses to guess between them.

environmentVariables.name: XCHAT_DATABASE_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Explicit path to the XChat SQLite file, skipping browser discovery entirely. Useful on a headless host: copy the file over from the machine that runs the browser and point this at it.

environmentVariables.name: TWIKIT_DOWNLOAD_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Directory for download_tweet_video output. Defaults to ~/Downloads/twikit-mcp/ when unset.
